evidence.reason: Clean planar diagram with 22 distinguishable tiles. Seven squares and three approximately standard equilateral triangles can be identified. The remaining twelve tiles have narrow isosceles triangular outlines, approximately twice as long as their short bases; these are not the catalog's tall right triangles or either equilateral size. Their observed outlines are retained as unknown rather than subdivided or forced into supported profiles. Radial tips meet only locally, not along full edges.
